scope: Read every observed/scheduled event and every timing against complete cited quote. Spot-checked prediction claims and ran numeric-value-presence screen over every event. No legacy data used.
findings: No definite peer-to-own observed promotion found. Main issues are bare due claims promoted to scheduled and unsupported forecast/timing values under wrong citations.
advisories: Many scheduled events include expected/guessed target/value alongside real scheduled ordinal. UI must retain caveat that target/value may be expected; alternatively split into scheduled unknown target and predicted target/value. Explicit cases include predicted Slovenia CVD R6, New Mexico language R5, and Poland SDG R3.
Ordinal-only retrospective own round/deadline references were accepted with unknown target/value (not filled from peer data).
Values accompanying own confirmed prompt are source-reported values, not independently graded correctness or necessarily evaluator-confirmed receipt.
